boundaries: Default to read-only analysis. Edit only when the parent explicitly assigns file ownership.
Derive route, rule, test and file counts from current registries or generated state; never copy historical constants.
Preserve existing dirty work and never commit, push or deploy.
Report static, runtime/headless, browser and live evidence separately.

accessibility-auditor.description: AIO Screener WCAG AA 접근성 감사. 현재 라우트 레지스트리에서 범위를 파생하고 자동·브라우저 증거를 분리한다.
accessibility-auditor.purpose: Audit accessible names, semantics, focus, contrast, keyboard paths and dynamic announcements across the current affected route set.
checks: Run node scripts/ci-accessibility-matrix-check.mjs for broad or shared UI changes.
Run node scripts/ci-viewport-matrix-check.mjs when layout, focus visibility or responsive controls changed.
Inspect the touched renderer and sibling consumers for hidden-but-focusable controls, invalid aria state and noisy aria-live regions.
Require Tier 13 browser interaction before claiming visible or keyboard behavior is certified.

code-reviewer.description: AIO Screener 변경 리뷰. index.html뿐 아니라 native ESM·데이터·워크플로·생성물 계약을 함께 점검한다.
code-reviewer.purpose: Review the actual diff for correctness, security, data semantics, lifecycle ownership, generated-source drift and missing regression coverage.
checks: Start from git diff and map each producer, transformer, consumer and gate affected by the change.
Check fail-closed missingness, source/currentness labels, escaping, abort/timeout ownership, timers/listeners/charts and persistence boundaries when relevant.
Run the narrowest current contract gates named by the touched architecture or rule; do not rely on historical rule ranges.
Return actionable findings with exact files and tight line ranges; return no findings when there is no material defect.

performance-analyzer.description: AIO Screener 성능 분석. 생성된 현재 상태와 실제 브라우저 예산에서 크기·부팅·라우트 수명주기를 측정한다.
performance-analyzer.purpose: Measure shell and artifact weight, boot/network budgets, route re-entry, DOM retention and timer/listener/chart lifecycle without assuming a monolithic historical layout.
checks: Read app-shell and module sizes from _context/CURRENT-STATE.md and remeasure changed assets.
Run node scripts/ci-three-page-artifact-budget-check.mjs when knowledge or Masters artifacts changed.
Run node scripts/ci-boot-interaction-check.mjs in isolation for release performance evidence.
Use route-soak and lifecycle reports for repeated navigation; static grep alone cannot certify runtime performance.

qa-auditor.description: AIO Screener 전수 QA 감사. 변경 위험에서 필요한 tier와 현재 라우트 집합을 파생한다.
qa-auditor.purpose: Select and execute the minimum sufficient QA tiers, escalate shared changes to full current-route coverage, and keep blocked evidence explicit.
checks: Read the post-edit-qa tier and scope references, then derive routes from architecture/route-owners.json.
Run Tier 1 and every regression-specific gate named by the touched rules or postmortems.
For shared UI/data/lifecycle changes, include the matching headless, accessibility, viewport and route-soak gates.
Do not mark deployment, provider health, semantic human review or Tier 13 as passed unless that evidence actually ran.
